trans.sense: Mustela erminea, M. richardsonii, M. haidarum

glosses: A weasel found in northern latitudes (Mustela erminea in Eurasia, Alaska, and the Arctic, Mustela haidarum in Haida Gwaii, Mustela richardsonii in the rest of North America); its dark brown fur turns white in winter, apart from the black tip of the tail.
The white fur of this animal, traditionally seen as a symbol of purity and used for judges' robes.

raw_glosses: (by extension, figuratively) The office of a judge.
(heraldry) The fur of this animal, used as a heraldic tincture: a white field with a repeating pattern of stylized black spots.
glosses: The fur of this animal, used as a heraldic tincture: a white field with a repeating pattern of stylized black spots.
Any of various moths, especially in the family Yponomeutidae

examples.text: She was going to, erm... the salon, I think.

glosses: Used in hesitant speech, or to express uncertainty.

examples.text: Erm, I don't think that was supposed to happen.

– Bob would never say something like that!
– Erm, he just did.

glosses: Used to express embarrassment or subtle disagreement.
